_comment: Glen's manual catalog corrections, applied over the LLM-cleaned enrichment by scripts/apply_enrichment.py. Each entry overrides ingredients, description and bottle_type (and clears gk_stale if the formula is now authoritative here). Slugs here override the HOLD list. ingredients_source 'manual' = Glen-verified.

tmg-syntropy-powder-trimethylglycine.note: TMG Syntropy Powder includes Vitamin B15 & B16 (Glen 2026-06-05)

humic-acid.note: Single-ingredient Pure Powder (Glen). FMP 'Fulvic Acid Complex' match was wrong.

magnesium-taurate.note: Single-ingredient Pure Powder (Glen). FMP 'Magnesium Glycinate' match was wrong.

fibrosolve.note: SKU 1 of the Fibrolysis 3-SKU line. BOM from FMP product 1191, extract 2026-08-31: 15+100+25+350 = 490 mg, matching FMP zc_total_mg 490. The four zero-quantity companion lines in FMP (incl. raw 4259 Nattokinase, the marker for raw 4504 Bacillus subtilis) carry no mass and are not panel rows. Page previously had no ingredients panel at all.

ingredients.name: Green Tea Extract, Organic (98% Polyphenols / 50% EGCG)

fibrolysis-factors.description: Anti-fibrotic botanical formula, five standardized actives at 487.5 mg per capsule. Take 1 capsule daily with food.
fibrolysis-factors.note: Reformulated 2026-06-06 (SKU 2 of the Fibrolysis 3-SKU line); the old enzyme-led formula moved to Fibrosolve. BOM from FMP product 356, extract 2026-08-31: 50+200+125+75+37.5 = 487.5 mg, matching FMP zc_total_mg 487.5. The three zero-quantity marker lines (raw 5604 Green Tea EGCG, 4609 Salvia miltiorrhiza, 5583 High AKBA Boswellic Acid 90%) carry no mass; they had been rendering as three extra panel rows, one of them as '(unnamed FMP ingredient 5583)'. Their botanical identity is folded into the dosed line, their conflicting standardization percentages are not. Dosing from FMP dosage/dosage_timing/dosage_freq on the same extract.
